policy: External corpora are kept in separate lanes for diagnosis, escalation evaluation, language style, and jurisdictional safety. No source is treated as clinical validation.

sources.name: DDXPlus
sources.notes: About 1.3M synthetic patients, 49 pathologies, structured evidence and probability-weighted differential diagnoses. Not Southeast Asian and not recorded dialogue.

sources.name: CARE-Bench public split
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 dataset; code license unspecified
sources.notes: 439 public cases and 925 labeled disclosure prefixes. Keep out of training and respect source-level terms.

sources.name: OpenMed MedDialog
sources.license: Apache-2.0 as stated by dataset card
sources.notes: Single-turn patient/doctor pairs without dependable diagnosis labels; source responses may be inaccurate.

sources.name: Singapore MOH — Getting medical help
sources.license: Government website terms; facts encoded with source attribution
sources.notes: Emergency warning signs and local care pathway. This overrides learned stop confidence but does not supply diagnosis labels.

sources.name: Singapore MOH Health Diseases and Conditions
sources.notes: 42 condition names only; no symptoms, conversations, diagnoses, or outcomes.

sources.name: ViMed-SFT
sources.license: Apache-2.0 as stated by dataset card
sources.notes: 10,085 Vietnamese medical QA conversations; crawl and label provenance require review before training.

sources.name: IndoHealth-NLP NCD sample
sources.notes: 200-row public sample; educational nurse-triage responses, not diagnosis labels.

sources.name: SEADialogues
sources.notes: 32,000 culturally grounded dialogues across eight regional languages; it is not medical data.

sources.name: ViMQ
sources.notes: 9,000 patient questions with intent and medical-entity annotations; not a diagnostic conversation corpus.

sources.name: Meddies Consultant / HoangHa medical-data
sources.license: other / custom terms not established in card
sources.notes: Large Vietnamese-first multi-turn corpus with disease targets, but licensing and synthetic-generation provenance need resolution.
